en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a straight European city street lined with tall late‑19th‑century brick townhouses featuring ornate stone window frames, shutters, and small balconies. The buildings are tightly packed and uniform in height. A few pedestrians in long dark clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a small horse‑drawn or hand‑pulled cart with several people stands in the middle of the cobbled street. Gas‑style street lamps appear along the right side. The sky is overcast and there is no visible printed caption on the image.
